output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that increases the balance of the attacker without reducing the balance of the token owner, allowing attackers to arbitrarily increase balances.

The '_transfer' function has an integer overflow in these lines: require (balanceOf[_from] >= _value); require (balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to]);, allowing attackers to cause a denial of service (DOS) by reducing the balances of token recipients.
The 'transfer' function calls the '_transfer' function, which has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to cause a denial of service (DOS) in the transfer function.
